11	interfaces, and writes a JSON report to
12	`outputs/public_reproduction_report.json`.

14	The report contains named observations that are useful when investigating the
15	calculation: the input units and region/material counts, mesh size, principal-axis
16	orientation, plastic-centroid coordinates, and global/principal plastic-capacity
17	quantities.  Values are reported in the fixture's length, stress, force, and moment
18	units; the capacity fields therefore carry the corresponding force-times-length
19	unit.  The report is finite and non-empty when the workflow completes.

91	        self.materials: list[pre.Material] = []
92	
93	        if isinstance(self.geometry, sp_geom.CompoundGeometry):
94	            self.materials = [geom.material for geom in self.geometry.geoms]
95	        else:
96	            self.materials = [self.geometry.material]
97	
98	        # extract mesh data
99	        self._mesh_nodes = np.array(self.mesh["vertices"], dtype=float)
100	        self._mesh_elements = np.array(self.mesh["triangles"], dtype=int)
101	        self._mesh_attributes = np.array(
102	            self.mesh["triangle_attributes"].T[0], dtype=int
103	        )
104	
105	        # swap mid-node order to retain node ordering consistency
106	        self._mesh_elements[:, [3, 4, 5]] = self._mesh_elements[:, [5, 3, 4]]
107	
108	        # save total number of nodes in mesh
109	        self.num_nodes = len(self._mesh_nodes)
110	
111	        # initialise material_groups variable
112	        self.material_groups: list[MaterialGroup] = []
113	
114	        # check that the right number of material properties are specified
115	        msg = f"Number of materials ({len(self.materials)}), "
116	        msg += f"should match the number of regions ({max(self._mesh_attributes) + 1})."
117	        assert len(self.materials) == max(self._mesh_attributes) + 1, msg
118	
119	        # add a MaterialGroup object to the material_groups list for each uniquely
120	        # encountered material
121	        for idx, material in enumerate(self.materials):
122	            # add the first material to the list
123	            if idx == 0:
124	                self.material_groups.append(
125	                    MaterialGroup(num_nodes=self.num_nodes, material=material)
126	                )
127	            else:
128	                # if the material hasn't been encountered
129	                if material not in self.materials[:idx]:
130	                    self.material_groups.append(
131	                        MaterialGroup(num_nodes=self.num_nodes, material=material)
132	                    )
133	
134	        # initialise list holding all element objects
135	        self.elements: list[fea.Tri6] = []
136	
137	        # build the mesh one element at a time
138	        for i, node_ids in enumerate(self._mesh_elements):
139	            # create a list containing the vertex and mid-node coordinates
140	            coords = self._mesh_nodes[node_ids, :].transpose()
141	
142	            # if materials are specified, get the material
143	            if self.materials:
144	                # get attribute index of current element
145	                att_el = self._mesh_attributes[i]
146	
147	                # fetch the material
148	                material = self.materials[att_el]
149	            # if there are no materials specified, use a default material
150	            else:  # Should not happen but included as failsafe
151	                material = pre.DEFAULT_MATERIAL
152	
153	            # add tri6 elements to the mesh
154	            new_element = fea.Tri6(i, coords, node_ids, material)
155	            self.elements.append(new_element)
156	
157	            # add element to relevant MaterialGroup
158	            for group in self.material_groups:
159	                if material is group.material:
160	                    group.add_element(element=new_element)
161	                    break
162	
163	        # create the search tree
164	        if self.geometry.mesh is not None:
165	            p_mesh = [
166	                Polygon(self.geometry.mesh["vertices"][tri][0:3])
167	                for tri in self.geometry.mesh["triangles"]
168	            ]
169	            self.mesh_search_tree = STRtree(p_mesh)
170	
171	        # initialise class storing section properties
172	        self.section_props = post.SectionProperties()
173	
174	    def calculate_geometric_properties(self) -> None:
175	        r"""Calculates geometric (area) properties.
176	
177	        Calculates the geometric properties of the cross-section and stores them in the
178	        :class:`~sectionproperties.post.post.SectionProperties` object contained in the
179	        ``section_props`` variable.
180	
181	        Note:
182	            If materials are specified for the cross-section, the moments of area and
183	            section moduli are elastic modulus weighted.
184	
185	        .. admonition:: Geometric Properties
186	
187	          Below is a list of the section properties calculated by the
188	          ``calculate_geometric_properties()`` method:
189	
190	          - Cross-sectional area
191	          - Cross-sectional perimeter
192	          - Cross-sectional mass
193	          - Area weighted material properties (composite only) :math:`E_{eff}`,
194	            :math:`G_{eff}`, :math:`{\nu}_{eff}`
195	          - Modulus weighted area (axial rigidity)
196	          - First moments of area
197	          - Second moments of area about the global axis
198	          - Second moments of area about the centroidal axis
199	          - Elastic centroid
200	          - Centroidal section moduli
201	          - Radii of gyration
202	          - Principal axis properties
203	        """
204	
205	        def calculate_geom(progress: Progress | None = None) -> None:
206	            # initialise properties
207	            self.section_props.area = 0.0
208	            self.section_props.perimeter = 0.0
209	            self.section_props.mass = 0.0
210	            self.section_props.ea = 0.0
211	            self.section_props.ga = 0.0
212	            self.section_props.qx = 0.0
213	            self.section_props.qy = 0.0
214	            self.section_props.ixx_g = 0.0
215	            self.section_props.iyy_g = 0.0
216	            self.section_props.ixy_g = 0.0
217	
218	            # calculate perimeter
219	            self.section_props.perimeter = self.geometry.calculate_perimeter()
220	
221	            if progress:
222	                task = progress.add_task(
223	                    description="[red]Calculating geometric properties",
224	                    total=len(self.elements),
225	                )
226	            else:
227	                task = None
228	
229	            # calculate global geometric properties
230	            for el in self.elements:
231	                (
232	                    area,
233	                    qx,
234	                    qy,
235	                    ixx_g,
236	                    iyy_g,
237	                    ixy_g,
238	                    e,
239	                    g,
240	                    rho,
241	                ) = el.geometric_properties()
242	                self.section_props.area += area
243	                self.section_props.mass += area * rho
244	                self.section_props.ea += area * e
245	                self.section_props.ga += area * g
246	                self.section_props.qx += qx * e
247	                self.section_props.qy += qy * e
248	                self.section_props.ixx_g += ixx_g * e
249	                self.section_props.iyy_g += iyy_g * e
250	                self.section_props.ixy_g += ixy_g * e
251	
252	                if progress and task is not None:
253	                    progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
254	
255	            self.section_props.nu_eff = (
256	                self.section_props.ea / (2 * self.section_props.ga) - 1
257	            )
258	            self.section_props.e_eff = self.section_props.ea / self.section_props.area
259	            self.section_props.g_eff = self.section_props.ga / self.section_props.area
260	            self.section_props.calculate_elastic_centroid()
261	            self.section_props.calculate_centroidal_properties(
262	                node_list=self.mesh["vertices"]
263	            )
264	
265	            if progress and task is not None:
266	                msg = "[bold green]:white_check_mark: Geometric analysis complete"
267	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
268	
269	        # conduct geometric analysis
270	        if self.time_info:
271	            progress = solver.create_progress()  # create progress bar
272	
273	            progress_table = Table.grid()  # create table to print progress in
274	            panel = Panel.fit(
275	                renderable=progress,
276	                title="[bold]Geometric Analysis",
277	                border_style="red",
278	                padding=(1, 1),
279	            )
280	            progress_table.add_row(panel)
281	
282	            with Live(progress_table, refresh_per_second=10) as live:
283	                calculate_geom(progress=progress)  # calculate geometric properties
284	                panel.border_style = "green"
285	                live.refresh()
286	
287	            print()  # create a blank line
288	        else:
289	            calculate_geom()  # calculate geometric properties

291	    def calculate_warping_properties(
292	        self,
293	        solver_type: str = "direct",
294	    ) -> None:
295	        """Calculates warping properties.
296	
297	        Calculates all the warping properties of the cross-section and stores them in
298	        the :class:`~sectionproperties.post.post.SectionProperties` object contained in
299	        the ``section_props`` variable.
300	
301	        Args:
302	            solver_type: Solver used for solving systems of linear equations, either
303	                using the ``"direct"`` method or ``"cgs"`` iterative method
304	
305	        Raises:
306	            RuntimeError: If the geometric properties have not been calculated prior to
307	                calling this method
308	
309	        Note:
310	            If materials are specified, the values calculated for the torsion constant,
311	            warping constant and shear areas are elastic modulus weighted.
312	
313	        Warning:
314	            The geometric properties must be calculated prior to the calculation of the
315	            warping properties.
316	
317	        .. admonition:: Warping Properties
318	
319	          Below is a list of the section properties calculated by the
320	          ``calculate_warping_properties()`` method:
321	
322	          - Torsion constant
323	          - Shear centre
324	          - Shear area
325	          - Warping constant
326	          - Monosymmetry constant
327	        """
328	        # check that a geometric analysis has been performed
329	        if None in [
330	            self.section_props.area,
331	            self.section_props.ixx_c,
332	            self.section_props.cx,
333	        ]:
334	            err = "Calculate geometric properties before performing a warping analysis."
335	            raise RuntimeError(err)
336	
337	        # check if any geometry are disjoint
338	        if isinstance(self.geometry, sp_geom.CompoundGeometry):
339	            polygons = [sec_geom.geom for sec_geom in self.geometry.geoms]
340	            disjoint_regions = sp_geom.check_geometry_disjoint(lop=polygons)
341	            if disjoint_regions:
342	                msg = "\nThe section geometry contains disjoint regions which is "
343	                msg += "invalid for warping analysis.\n Please revise your geometry to "
344	                msg += "ensure there is connectivity between all regions."
345	                warnings.warn(msg)
346	
347	        # create a new Section with the origin shifted to the centroid for calculation
348	        # of the warping properties such that the Lagrangian multiplier approach can be
349	        # utilised
350	        warping_section = Section(geometry=self.geometry)
351	
352	        # shift the coordinates of each element
353	        # N.B. the mesh class attribute remains unshifted!
354	        cx, cy = self.get_c()
355	
356	        for el in warping_section.elements:
357	            el.coords[0, :] -= cx
358	            el.coords[1, :] -= cy
359	
360	        # entire warping analysis is contained in following definition
361	        def warping_analysis(progress: Progress | None = None) -> None:
362	            # assemble stiffness matrix and load vector for warping function
363	            if progress:
364	                msg = f"[red]Assembling {self.num_nodes}x{self.num_nodes} stiffness "
365	                msg += "matrix"
366	                task = progress.add_task(
367	                    description=msg,
368	                    total=len(warping_section.elements),
369	                )
370	                k_lg, f_torsion = warping_section.assemble_torsion(
371	                    progress=progress, task=task
372	                )
373	
374	                msg = f"[green]:white_check_mark: {self.num_nodes}x{self.num_nodes} "
375	                msg += "stiffness matrix assembled"
376	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
377	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
378	            else:
379	                k_lg, f_torsion = warping_section.assemble_torsion()
380	
381	            # ILU decomposition of stiffness matrices
382	            def ilu_decomp(
383	                progress: Progress | None = None,
384	                task: TaskID | None = None,
385	            ) -> linalg.LinearOperator:
386	                # ILU decomposition on Lagrangian stiffness matrix
387	                k_lg_precond = linalg.LinearOperator(
388	                    (self.num_nodes + 1, self.num_nodes + 1), linalg.spilu(k_lg).solve
389	                )
390	
391	                if progress and task:
392	                    progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
393	
394	                return k_lg_precond
395	
396	            # if the cgs method is used, perform ILU decomposition
397	            if solver_type == "cgs":
398	                if progress:
399	                    task = progress.add_task(
400	                        description="[red]Performing ILU decomposition",
401	                        total=2,
402	                    )
403	                    k_lg_precond = ilu_decomp(progress=progress, task=task)
404	
405	                    msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: ILU decomposition complete"
406	                    progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
407	                else:
408	                    k_lg_precond = ilu_decomp()
409	
410	            # solve for warping function
411	            def solve_warping() -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
412	                if solver_type == "cgs" and k_lg_precond:
413	                    omega = solver.solve_cgs_lagrange(
414	                        k_lg=k_lg, f=f_torsion, m=k_lg_precond
415	                    )
416	                elif solver_type == "direct":
417	                    omega = solver.solve_direct_lagrange(k_lg=k_lg, f=f_torsion)
418	                else:
419	                    raise ValueError("solver_type must be 'cgs' or 'direct'.")
420	
421	                return omega
422	
423	            if progress:
424	                msg = f"[red]Solving warping function ({solver_type})"
425	                task = progress.add_task(description=msg, total=1)
426	
427	                omega = solve_warping()
428	
429	                progress.update(task, advance=1)
430	
431	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Warping function solved "
432	                msg += f"({solver_type})"
433	                progress.update(task, description=msg)
434	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
435	            else:
436	                omega = solve_warping()
437	
438	            # save the warping function
439	            self.section_props.omega = omega
440	
441	            # determine the torsion constant
442	            if self.is_composite():
443	                ixx_c, iyy_c, ixy_c = self.get_eic()
444	            else:
445	                ixx_c, iyy_c, ixy_c = self.get_ic()
446	
447	            self.section_props.j = ixx_c + iyy_c - omega.dot(f_torsion)
448	
449	            # assemble shear function load vectors
450	            if self.is_composite():
451	                nu_eff = self.get_nu_eff()
452	            else:
453	                nu_eff = 0.0
454	
455	            def assemble_shear_load(
456	                progress: Progress | None = None,
457	                task: TaskID | None = None,
458	            ) -> tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float64], npt.NDArray[np.float64]]:
459	                f_psi = np.zeros(self.num_nodes)
460	                f_phi = np.zeros(self.num_nodes)
461	
462	                for el in warping_section.elements:
463	                    f_psi_el, f_phi_el = el.shear_load_vectors(
464	                        ixx=ixx_c,
465	                        iyy=iyy_c,
466	                        ixy=ixy_c,
467	                        nu=nu_eff,
468	                    )
469	                    f_psi[el.node_ids] += f_psi_el
470	                    f_phi[el.node_ids] += f_phi_el
471	
472	                    if progress and task:
473	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
474	
475	                return f_psi, f_phi
476	
477	            if progress:
478	                task = progress.add_task(
479	                    description="[red]Assembling shear function vectors",
480	                    total=len(warping_section.elements),
481	                )
482	                f_psi, f_phi = assemble_shear_load(progress=progress, task=task)
483	
484	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Shear function vectors assembled"
485	                progress.update(task, description=msg)
486	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
487	            else:
488	                f_psi, f_phi = assemble_shear_load()
489	
490	            # solve for shear functions psi and phi
491	            def solve_shear_functions(
492	                progress: Progress | None = None,
493	                task: TaskID | None = None,
494	            ) -> tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float64], npt.NDArray[np.float64]]:
495	                if solver_type == "cgs" and k_lg_precond:
496	                    psi_shear = solver.solve_cgs_lagrange(
497	                        k_lg=k_lg, f=f_psi, m=k_lg_precond
498	                    )
499	
500	                    if progress and task:
501	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
502	
503	                    phi_shear = solver.solve_cgs_lagrange(
504	                        k_lg=k_lg, f=f_phi, m=k_lg_precond
505	                    )
506	
507	                    if progress and task:
508	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
509	                else:
510	                    psi_shear = solver.solve_direct_lagrange(k_lg=k_lg, f=f_psi)
511	
512	                    if progress and task:
513	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
514	
515	                    phi_shear = solver.solve_direct_lagrange(k_lg=k_lg, f=f_phi)
516	
517	                    if progress and task:
518	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
519	
520	                return psi_shear, phi_shear
521	
522	            if progress:
523	                task = progress.add_task(
524	                    description=f"[red]Solving shear functions ({solver_type})",
525	                    total=2,
526	                )
527	                psi_shear, phi_shear = solve_shear_functions(
528	                    progress=progress, task=task
529	                )
530	
531	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Shear functions solved "
532	                msg += f"({solver_type})"
533	                progress.update(task, description=msg)
534	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
535	            else:
536	                psi_shear, phi_shear = solve_shear_functions()
537	
538	            # save the shear functions
539	            self.section_props.psi_shear = psi_shear
540	            self.section_props.phi_shear = phi_shear
541	
542	            # assemble shear centre and warping moment integrals
543	            def assemble_sc_warping_integrals(
544	                progress: Progress | None = None,
545	                task: TaskID | None = None,
546	            ) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:
547	                sc_xint = 0.0
548	                sc_yint = 0.0
549	                q_omega = 0.0
550	                i_omega = 0.0
551	                i_xomega = 0.0
552	                i_yomega = 0.0
553	
554	                for el in warping_section.elements:
555	                    (
556	                        sc_xint_el,
557	                        sc_yint_el,
558	                        q_omega_el,
559	                        i_omega_el,
560	                        i_xomega_el,
561	                        i_yomega_el,
562	                    ) = el.shear_warping_integrals(
563	                        ixx=ixx_c,
564	                        iyy=iyy_c,
565	                        ixy=ixy_c,
566	                        omega=omega[el.node_ids],
567	                    )
568	
569	                    sc_xint += sc_xint_el
570	                    sc_yint += sc_yint_el
571	                    q_omega += q_omega_el
572	                    i_omega += i_omega_el
573	                    i_xomega += i_xomega_el
574	                    i_yomega += i_yomega_el
575	
576	                    if progress and task:
577	                        progress.update(task, advance=1)
578	
579	                return sc_xint, sc_yint, q_omega, i_omega, i_xomega, i_yomega
580	
581	            if progress:
582	                task = progress.add_task(
583	                    description="[red]Assembling shear and warping integrals",
584	                    total=len(warping_section.elements),
585	                )
586	                (
587	                    sc_xint,
588	                    sc_yint,
589	                    q_omega,
590	                    i_omega,
591	                    i_xomega,
592	                    i_yomega,
593	                ) = assemble_sc_warping_integrals(progress=progress, task=task)
594	
595	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Shear and warping integrals assembled"
596	                progress.update(task, description=msg)
597	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
598	            else:
599	                (
600	                    sc_xint,
601	                    sc_yint,
602	                    q_omega,
603	                    i_omega,
604	                    i_xomega,
605	                    i_yomega,
606	                ) = assemble_sc_warping_integrals()
607	
608	            # calculate shear centres (elasticity approach)
609	            phi = self.get_phi()
610	            delta_s = 2 * (1 + nu_eff) * (ixx_c * iyy_c - ixy_c**2)
611	            x_se = (1 / delta_s) * ((nu_eff / 2 * sc_xint) - f_torsion.dot(phi_shear))
612	            y_se = (1 / delta_s) * ((nu_eff / 2 * sc_yint) + f_torsion.dot(psi_shear))
613	            x11_se, y22_se = fea.principal_coordinate(phi=phi, x=x_se, y=y_se)
614	
615	            # calculate shear centres (Trefftz's approach)
616	            x_st = (ixy_c * i_xomega - iyy_c * i_yomega) / (ixx_c * iyy_c - ixy_c**2)
617	            y_st = (ixx_c * i_xomega - ixy_c * i_yomega) / (ixx_c * iyy_c - ixy_c**2)
618	
619	            # save shear centres
620	            self.section_props.delta_s = delta_s
621	            self.section_props.x_se = x_se
622	            self.section_props.y_se = y_se
623	            self.section_props.x11_se = x11_se
624	            self.section_props.y22_se = y22_se
625	            self.section_props.x_st = x_st
626	            self.section_props.y_st = y_st
627	
628	            # calculate warping constant
629	            if self.is_composite():
630	                ea = self.get_ea()
631	            else:
632	                ea = self.get_area()
633	
634	            self.section_props.gamma = (
635	                i_omega - q_omega**2 / ea - y_se * i_xomega + x_se * i_yomega
636	            )
637	
638	            def assemble_shear_deformation(
639	                progress: Progress | None = None,
640	                task: TaskID | None = None,
641	            ) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
642	                # assemble shear deformation coefficients
643	                kappa_x = 0.0
644	                kappa_y = 0.0
645	                kappa_xy = 0.0
646	
647	                for el in warping_section.elements:
648	                    (kappa_x_el, kappa_y_el, kappa_xy_el) = el.shear_coefficients(
649	                        ixx=ixx_c,
650	                        iyy=iyy_c,
651	                        ixy=ixy_c,
652	                        psi_shear=psi_shear[el.node_ids],
653	                        phi_shear=phi_shear[el.node_ids],
654	                        nu=nu_eff,
655	                    )
656	
657	                    kappa_x += kappa_x_el
658	                    kappa_y += kappa_y_el
659	                    kappa_xy += kappa_xy_el
660	
661	                    if progress and task:
662	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
663	
664	                return kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy
665	
666	            if progress:
667	                task = progress.add_task(
668	                    description="[red]Assembling shear deformation coefficients",
669	                    total=len(warping_section.elements),
670	                )
671	                kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy = assemble_shear_deformation(
672	                    progress=progress, task=task
673	                )
674	
675	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Shear deformation coefficients "
676	                msg += "assembled"
677	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
678	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
679	            else:
680	                kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy = assemble_shear_deformation()
681	
682	            # calculate shear areas wrt global axis
683	            self.section_props.a_sx = delta_s**2 / kappa_x
684	            self.section_props.a_sy = delta_s**2 / kappa_y
685	            self.section_props.a_sxy = delta_s**2 / kappa_xy
686	
687	            # calculate shear areas wrt principal bending axis:
688	            area = self.get_area()
689	            alpha_xx = kappa_x * area / delta_s**2
690	            alpha_yy = kappa_y * area / delta_s**2
691	            alpha_xy = kappa_xy * area / delta_s**2
692	
693	            # rotate the tensor by the principal axis angle
694	            phi_rad = phi * np.pi / 180
695	            r = np.array(
696	                [
697	                    [np.cos(phi_rad), np.sin(phi_rad)],
698	                    [-np.sin(phi_rad), np.cos(phi_rad)],
699	                ]
700	            )
701	
702	            rotated_alpha = r.dot(
703	                np.array([[alpha_xx, alpha_xy], [alpha_xy, alpha_yy]])
704	            ).dot(np.transpose(r))
705	
706	            # recalculate the shear area based on the rotated alpha value
707	            self.section_props.a_s11 = area / rotated_alpha[0, 0]
708	            self.section_props.a_s22 = area / rotated_alpha[1, 1]
709	
710	            # calculate the monosymmetry consants
711	            def calculate_monosymmetry_integrals(
712	                progress: Progress | None = None,
713	                task: TaskID | None = None,
714	            ) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
715	                int_x = 0.0
716	                int_y = 0.0
717	                int_11 = 0.0
718	                int_22 = 0.0
719	
720	                for el in warping_section.elements:
721	                    (
722	                        int_x_el,
723	                        int_y_el,
724	                        int_11_el,
725	                        int_22_el,
726	                    ) = el.monosymmetry_integrals(phi=phi)
727	
728	                    int_x += int_x_el
729	                    int_y += int_y_el
730	                    int_11 += int_11_el
731	                    int_22 += int_22_el
732	
733	                    if progress and task:
734	                        progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
735	
736	                return (int_x, int_y, int_11, int_22)
737	
738	            if progress:
739	                task = progress.add_task(
740	                    description="[red]Assembling monosymmetry integrals",
741	                    total=len(self.elements),
742	                )
743	                int_x, int_y, int_11, int_22 = calculate_monosymmetry_integrals(
744	                    progress=progress, task=task
745	                )
746	
747	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Monosymmetry integrals assembled"
748	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
749	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
750	            else:
751	                int_x, int_y, int_11, int_22 = calculate_monosymmetry_integrals()
752	
753	            # calculate the monosymmetry constants
754	            if self.is_composite():
755	                i11_c, i22_c = self.get_eip()
756	            else:
757	                i11_c, i22_c = self.get_ip()
758	
759	            self.section_props.beta_x_plus = -int_x / ixx_c + 2 * y_se
760	            self.section_props.beta_x_minus = int_x / ixx_c - 2 * y_se
761	            self.section_props.beta_y_plus = -int_y / iyy_c + 2 * x_se
762	            self.section_props.beta_y_minus = int_y / iyy_c - 2 * x_se
763	            self.section_props.beta_11_plus = -int_11 / i11_c + 2 * y22_se
764	            self.section_props.beta_11_minus = int_11 / i11_c - 2 * y22_se
765	            self.section_props.beta_22_plus = -int_22 / i22_c + 2 * x11_se
766	            self.section_props.beta_22_minus = int_22 / i22_c - 2 * x11_se
767	
768	        # conduct warping analysis
769	        if self.time_info:
770	            # create warping progress
771	            progress = solver.create_progress()
772	            total_task = progress.add_task(
773	                description="[bold red]Conducting warping analysis...", total=7
774	            )

776	            progress_table = Table.grid()
777	            panel = Panel.fit(
778	                renderable=progress,

780	                border_style="red",
781	                padding=(1, 1),
782	            )
783	            progress_table.add_row(panel)
784	
785	            with Live(progress_table, refresh_per_second=10) as live:
786	                warping_analysis(progress=progress)
787	
788	                msg = "[bold green]:white_check_mark: Warping analysis completed"
789	                progress.update(task_id=total_task, description=msg)

794	            print()

798	    def calculate_frame_properties(
799	        self,
800	        solver_type: str = "direct",
801	    ) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:
802	        """Calculates section properties to be used for frame analysis.
803	
804	        Calculates and returns the properties required for a frame analysis. The
805	        properties are also stored in the
806	        :class:`~sectionproperties.post.post.SectionProperties` object contained in the
807	        ``section_props`` variable.
808	
809	        This method is more efficient than running a geometric and warping analysis as
810	        unnecessary values are not calculated.
811	
812	        Args:
813	            solver_type: Solver used for solving systems of linear equations, either
814	                using the ``"direct"`` method or ``"cgs"`` iterative method
815	
816	        Returns:
817	            Cross-section properties to be used for a frame analysis (``area``, ``ixx``,
818	            ``iyy``, ``ixy``, ``j``, ``phi``)
819	
820	        Note:
821	            If materials are specified, the values calculated for the moments of area
822	            and the torsion constant are elastic modulus weighted.
823	
824	        .. admonition:: Warping Properties
825	
826	          Below is a list of the section properties calculated by the
827	          ``calculate_frame_properties()`` method:
828	
829	          - Cross-sectional area
830	          - Second moments of area about the centroidal axis
831	          - Torsion constant
832	          - Principal axis angle
833	        """
834	
835	        def calculate_geom(progress: Progress | None = None) -> None:
836	            # initialise geometric properties
837	            self.section_props.area = 0.0
838	            self.section_props.ea = 0.0
839	            self.section_props.qx = 0.0
840	            self.section_props.qy = 0.0
841	            self.section_props.ixx_g = 0.0
842	            self.section_props.iyy_g = 0.0
843	            self.section_props.ixy_g = 0.0
844	            self.section_props.ixx_c = 0.0
845	            self.section_props.iyy_c = 0.0
846	            self.section_props.ixy_c = 0.0
847	            self.section_props.j = 0.0
848	            self.section_props.phi = 0.0
849	
850	            if progress:
851	                task = progress.add_task(
852	                    description="[red]Calculating geometric properties",
853	                    total=len(self.elements),
854	                )
855	            else:
856	                task = None
857	
858	            # calculate global geometric properties
859	            for el in self.elements:
860	                area, qx, qy, ixx_g, iyy_g, ixy_g, e, _, _ = el.geometric_properties()
861	
862	                self.section_props.area += area
863	                self.section_props.ea += area * e
864	                self.section_props.qx += qx * e
865	                self.section_props.qy += qy * e
866	                self.section_props.ixx_g += ixx_g * e
867	                self.section_props.iyy_g += iyy_g * e
868	                self.section_props.ixy_g += ixy_g * e
869	
870	                if progress and task is not None:
871	                    progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
872	
873	            # calculate elastic centroid location
874	            self.section_props.calculate_elastic_centroid()
875	
876	            # calculate second moments of area about the centroidal xy axis
877	            if self.is_composite():
878	                ea = self.get_ea()
879	                qx, qy = self.get_eq()
880	                ixx_g, iyy_g, ixy_g = self.get_eig()
881	            else:
882	                ea = self.get_area()
883	                qx, qy = self.get_q()
884	                ixx_g, iyy_g, ixy_g = self.get_ig()
885	
886	            self.section_props.ixx_c = ixx_g - qx**2 / ea
887	            self.section_props.iyy_c = iyy_g - qy**2 / ea
888	            self.section_props.ixy_c = ixy_g - qx * qy / ea
889	
890	            # calculate the principal axis angle
891	            if self.is_composite():
892	                ixx_c, iyy_c, ixy_c = self.get_eic()
893	            else:
894	                ixx_c, iyy_c, ixy_c = self.get_ic()
895	
896	            delta = (((ixx_c - iyy_c) / 2) ** 2 + ixy_c**2) ** 0.5
897	
898	            i11_c = (ixx_c + iyy_c) / 2 + delta
899	
900	            # calculate initial principal axis angle
901	            if abs(ixx_c - i11_c) < 1e-12 * i11_c:
902	                self.section_props.phi = 0.0
903	            else:
904	                self.section_props.phi = np.arctan2(ixx_c - i11_c, ixy_c) * 180 / np.pi
905	
906	            if progress and task is not None:
907	                msg = "[bold green]:white_check_mark: Geometric analysis complete"
908	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
909	
910	        # conduct geometric analysis
911	        if self.time_info:
912	            progress = solver.create_progress()  # create progress bar
913	
914	            progress_table = Table.grid()  # create table to print progress in
915	            panel = Panel.fit(
916	                renderable=progress,
917	                title="[bold]Geometric (Frame) Analysis",
918	                border_style="red",
919	                padding=(1, 1),
920	            )
921	            progress_table.add_row(panel)
922	
923	            with Live(progress_table, refresh_per_second=10) as live:
924	                calculate_geom(progress=progress)  # calculate geometric properties
925	                panel.border_style = "green"
926	                live.refresh()
927	
928	            print()  # create a blank line
929	        else:
930	            calculate_geom()  # calculate geometric properties
931	
932	        # entire warping analysis is contained in following definition
933	        def warping_analysis(progress: Progress | None = None) -> None:
934	            # create a new Section with the origin shifted to the centroid for
935	            # calculation of the warping properties
936	            warping_section = Section(geometry=self.geometry)
937	
938	            # shift the coordinates of each element N.B. the mesh class attribute
939	            # remains unshifted
940	            cx, cy = self.get_c()
941	            for el in warping_section.elements:
942	                el.coords[0, :] -= cx
943	                el.coords[1, :] -= cy
944	
945	            # assemble stiffness matrix and load vector for warping function
946	            if progress:
947	                msg = f"[red]Assembling {self.num_nodes}x{self.num_nodes} stiffness "
948	                msg += "matrix"
949	                task = progress.add_task(
950	                    description=msg,
951	                    total=len(warping_section.elements),
952	                )
953	                k_lg, f_torsion = warping_section.assemble_torsion(
954	                    progress=progress, task=task
955	                )
956	
957	                msg = f"[green]:white_check_mark: {self.num_nodes}x{self.num_nodes} "
958	                msg += "stiffness matrix assembled"
959	                progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
960	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
961	            else:
962	                k_lg, f_torsion = warping_section.assemble_torsion()
963	
964	            # ILU decomposition of stiffness matrices
965	            def ilu_decomp(
966	                progress: Progress | None = None,
967	                task: TaskID | None = None,
968	            ) -> linalg.LinearOperator:
969	                # ILU decomposition on Lagrangian stiffness matrix
970	                k_lg_precond = linalg.LinearOperator(
971	                    (self.num_nodes + 1, self.num_nodes + 1), linalg.spilu(k_lg).solve
972	                )
973	
974	                if progress and task:
975	                    progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
976	
977	                return k_lg_precond
978	
979	            # if the cgs method is used, perform ILU decomposition
980	            if solver_type == "cgs":
981	                if progress:
982	                    task = progress.add_task(
983	                        description="[red]Performing ILU decomposition",
984	                        total=2,
985	                    )
986	                    k_lg_precond = ilu_decomp(progress=progress, task=task)
987	
988	                    msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: ILU decomposition complete"
989	                    progress.update(task_id=task, description=msg)
990	                else:
991	                    k_lg_precond = ilu_decomp()
992	
993	            # solve for warping function
994	            def solve_warping() -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
995	                if solver_type == "cgs" and k_lg_precond:
996	                    omega = solver.solve_cgs_lagrange(
997	                        k_lg=k_lg, f=f_torsion, m=k_lg_precond
998	                    )
999	                elif solver_type == "direct":
1000	                    omega = solver.solve_direct_lagrange(k_lg=k_lg, f=f_torsion)
1001	                else:
1002	                    raise ValueError("solver_type must be 'cgs' or 'direct'.")
1003	
1004	                return omega
1005	
1006	            if progress:
1007	                msg = f"[red]Solving warping function ({solver_type})"
1008	                task = progress.add_task(description=msg, total=1)
1009	
1010	                omega = solve_warping()
1011	
1012	                progress.update(task, advance=1)
1013	
1014	                msg = "[green]:white_check_mark: Warping function solved "
1015	                msg += f"({solver_type})"
1016	                progress.update(task, description=msg)
1017	                progress.update(cast(TaskID, 0), advance=1)
1018	            else:
1019	                omega = solve_warping()
1020	
1021	            # save the warping function
1022	            self.section_props.omega = omega
1023	
1024	            # determine the torsion constant
1025	            if self.is_composite():
1026	                ixx_c, iyy_c, _ = self.get_eic()
1027	            else:
1028	                ixx_c, iyy_c, _ = self.get_ic()
1029	
1030	            self.section_props.j = ixx_c + iyy_c - omega.dot(f_torsion)
1031	
1032	        # conduct warping analysis
1033	        if self.time_info:
1034	            # create warping progress
1035	            progress = solver.create_progress()
1036	            total_task = progress.add_task(
1037	                description="[bold red]Conducting warping analysis...", total=2
1038	            )
1039	
1040	            progress_table = Table.grid()
1041	            panel = Panel.fit(
1042	                renderable=progress,
1043	                title="[bold]Warping (Frame) Analysis",
1044	                border_style="red",
1045	                padding=(1, 1),
1046	            )
1047	            progress_table.add_row(panel)
1048	
1049	            with Live(progress_table, refresh_per_second=10) as live:
1050	                warping_analysis(progress=progress)
1051	
1052	                msg = "[bold green]:white_check_mark: Warping analysis completed"
1053	                progress.update(task_id=total_task, description=msg)
1054	
1055	                panel.border_style = "green"
1056	                live.refresh()
1057	
1058	            print()
1059	        else:
1060	            warping_analysis()
1061	
1062	        # check all properties were calculated
1063	        assert self.section_props.area is not None
1064	        assert self.section_props.ixx_c is not None
1065	        assert self.section_props.iyy_c is not None
1066	        assert self.section_props.ixy_c is not None
1067	        assert self.section_props.j is not None
1068	        assert self.section_props.phi is not None
1069	
1070	        return (
1071	            self.section_props.area,
1072	            self.section_props.ixx_c,
1073	            self.section_props.iyy_c,
1074	            self.section_props.ixy_c,
1075	            self.section_props.j,
1076	            self.section_props.phi,
1077	        )

1079	    def calculate_plastic_properties(
1080	        self,
1081	        verbose: bool = False,
1082	    ) -> None:
1083	        """Calculates plastic properties.
1084	
1085	        Calculates the plastic properties of the cross-section and stores them in the
1086	        :class:`~sectionproperties.post.post.SectionProperties` object contained in
1087	        the ``section_props`` variable.

1089	        Args:
1090	            verbose: If set to True, the number of iterations required for each plastic
1091	                axis is printed to the terminal.
1092	
1093	        Raises:
1094	            RuntimeError: If the geometric properties have not been calculated prior to
1095	                calling this method
1096	
1097	        Note:
1098	            If materials are specified, the values calculated for the plastic section
1099	            moduli are displayed as plastic moments (i.e :math:`M_p = f_y S`) and the
1100	            shape factors are not calculated.
1101	
1102	        Warning:
1103	            The geometric properties must be calculated prior to the calculation of the
1104	            plastic properties.
1105	
1106	        .. admonition:: Plastic Properties
1107	
1108	          Below is a list of the section properties calculated by the
1109	          ``calculate_plastic_properties()`` method:
1110	
1111	          - Plastic centroids (centroidal and principal axes)
1112	          - Plastic section moduli (centroidal and principal axes)
1113	          - Shape factors, non-composite only (centroidal and principal axe)
1114	        """
1115	        # check that a geometric analysis has been performed
1116	        if self.section_props.cx is None:
1117	            err = "Calculate geometric properties before performing a plastic analysis."
1118	            raise RuntimeError(err)
1119	
1120	        # check if any geometry are overlapped
1121	        if isinstance(self.geometry, sp_geom.CompoundGeometry):

1123	            overlapped_regions = sp_geom.check_geometry_overlaps(lop=polygons)
1124

1127	                msg += " of these overlapped regions will be 'double counted' in the"
1128	                msg += "  plastic analysis which may result in incorrect values.\n"
1129	                msg += "If you do not intend for this double counting to occur, use"
1130	                msg += " a subtractive modelling approach to remove the overlapping"
1131	                msg += " region."
1132	                warnings.warn(msg)
1133	
1134	        def calc_plastic(progress: Progress | None = None) -> None:

1157	            print()
1158	        else:
1159	            calc_plastic()

1161	    def calculate_stress(
1162	        self,
1163	        n: float = 0.0,
1164	        vx: float = 0.0,
1165	        vy: float = 0.0,
1166	        mxx: float = 0.0,
1167	        myy: float = 0.0,
1168	        m11: float = 0.0,
1169	        m22: float = 0.0,
1170	        mzz: float = 0.0,
1171	    ) -> sp_stress_post.StressPost:
1172	        """Calculates cross-section stresses.
1173	
1174	        Calculates the cross-section stress resulting from design actions and returns
1175	        a :class:`~sectionproperties.post.stress_post.StressPost` object allowing the
1176	        post-processing of the stress results.
1177	
1178	        Args:
1179	            n: Axial force
1180	            vx: Shear force acting in the x-direction
1181	            vy: Shear force acting in the y-direction
1182	            mxx: Bending moment about the centroidal xx-axis
1183	            myy: Bending moment about the centroidal yy-axis
1184	            m11: Bending moment about the centroidal 11-axis
1185	            m22: Bending moment about the centroidal 22-axis
1186	            mzz: Torsion moment about the centroidal zz-axis
1187	
1188	        Returns:
1189	            Object for post-processing cross-section stresses
1190	
1191	        Raises:
1192	            RuntimeError: If a geometric and warping analysis (if required) have not
1193	                been performed prior to calling this method
1194	
1195	        Note:
1196	            A geometric analysis must be performed prior to performing a stress
1197	            analysis. Further, if the shear force or torsion is non-zero a warping
1198	            analysis must also be performed.
1199	        """
1200	        # check that a geometric analysis has been performed
1201	        if None in [
1202	            self.section_props.area,
1203	            self.section_props.ixx_c,
1204	            self.section_props.cx,
1205	        ]:
1206	            msg = "Perform a geometric analysis before carrying out a stress analysis."
1207	            raise RuntimeError(msg)
1208	
1209	        # check for warping analysis requirement
1210	        if vx != 0 or vy != 0 or mzz != 0:
1211	            warping = True
1212	
1213	            if self.section_props.omega is None:
1214	                msg = "Perform a warping analysis before carrying out a stress "
1215	                msg += "analysis with non-zero shear forces or torsion moment."
1216	                raise RuntimeError(msg)
1217	        else:
1218	            warping = False
1219	
1220	        def calc_stress(progress: Progress | None = None) -> sp_stress_post.StressPost:
1221	            if progress:
1222	                task = progress.add_task(
1223	                    description="[red]Calculating cross-section stresses",
1224	                    total=len(self.elements),
1225	                )
1226	            else:
1227	                task = None
1228	
1229	            # create stress post object
1230	            stress_post = sp_stress_post.StressPost(section=self)
1231	
1232	            # get relevant section properties
1233	            cx, cy = self.get_c()
1234	            phi = self.get_phi()
1235	
1236	            if self.is_composite():
1237	                ea = self.get_ea()
1238	                ixx, iyy, ixy = self.get_eic()
1239	                i11, i22 = self.get_eip()
1240	            else:
1241	                ea = self.get_area()
1242	                ixx, iyy, ixy = self.get_ic()
1243	                i11, i22 = self.get_ip()
1244	
1245	            if warping:
1246	                if self.is_composite():
1247	                    j = self.get_ej()
1248	                    nu = self.get_nu_eff()
1249	                else:
1250	                    j = self.get_j()
1251	                    nu = 0.0
1252	
1253	                delta_s = self.section_props.delta_s
1254	                omega = self.section_props.omega
1255	                psi_shear = self.section_props.psi_shear
1256	                phi_shear = self.section_props.phi_shear
1257	
1258	                assert delta_s is not None
1259	                assert omega is not None
1260	                assert psi_shear is not None
1261	                assert phi_shear is not None
1262	            else:
1263	                j = 0.0
1264	                nu = 0.0
1265	                delta_s = 0.0
1266	                omega = np.zeros(shape=self.num_nodes)
1267	                psi_shear = np.zeros(shape=self.num_nodes)
1268	                phi_shear = np.zeros(shape=self.num_nodes)
1269	
1270	            # loop through all material groups
1271	            for group in stress_post.material_groups:
1272	                # allocate nodal weights vector for nodal averaging
1273	                nodal_weights = np.zeros(self.num_nodes)
1274	                sr = group.stress_result
1275	
1276	                # loop through all elements in the material group
1277	                for el in group.elements:
1278	                    # get element omega and psi
1279	                    omega_el = omega[el.node_ids]
1280	                    psi_shear_el = psi_shear[el.node_ids]
1281	                    phi_shear_el = phi_shear[el.node_ids]
1282	
1283	                    (

1389	    def assemble_torsion(
1390	        self,
1391	        progress: Progress | None = None,
1392	        task: TaskID | None = None,
1393	    ) -> tuple[csc_matrix, npt.NDArray[np.float64]]:
1394	        """Assembles the warping stiffness matrix.
1395	
1396	        Assembles stiffness matrices to be used for the computation of warping
1397	        properties and the torsion load vector (``f_torsion``). A Lagrangian multiplier
1398	        (``k_lg``) stiffness matrix is returned. The stiffness matrix is assembled using
1399	        the sparse COO format and returned in the sparse CSC format.
1400	
1401	        Args:
1402	            progress: Rich progress object
1403	            task: Rich task object
1404	
1405	        Returns:
1406	            Lagrangian multiplier stiffness matrix and torsion load vector (``k_lg``,
1407	            ``f_torsion``)
1408	        """
1409	        # initialise variables
1410	        n_size = self.num_nodes  # size of matrix
1411	        row: list[float] = []  # list holding row indices
1412	        col: list[float] = []  # list holding column indices
1413	        data: list[float] = []  # list holding stiffness matrix entries
1414	        f_torsion = np.zeros(n_size)  # force vector array
1415	        c_torsion = np.zeros(n_size)  # constraint vector array
1416	
1417	        # loop through all elements in the mesh
1418	        for el in self.elements:
1419	            # determine number of nodes in the current element
1420	            n = len(el.node_ids)
1421	
1422	            # calculate the element stiffness matrix and torsion load vector
1423	            k_el, f_el, c_el = el.torsion_properties()
1424	
1425	            # assemble the torsion load vector
1426	            f_torsion[el.node_ids] += f_el
1427	            c_torsion[el.node_ids] += c_el
1428	
1429	            for node_id in el.node_ids:
1430	                row.extend([node_id] * n)
1431	            col.extend(list(el.node_ids) * n)
1432	            data.extend(k_el.flatten())
1433	
1434	            if progress and task:
1435	                progress.update(task_id=task, advance=1)
1436	
1437	        # construct Lagrangian multiplier matrix:
1438	        # column vector
1439	        row.extend(range(n_size))
1440	        col.extend([n_size] * n_size)
1441	        data.extend(c_torsion)
1442	
1443	        # row vector
1444	        row.extend([n_size] * n_size)
1445	        col.extend(range(n_size))
1446	        data.extend(c_torsion)
1447	
1448	        k_lg = coo_matrix(
1449	            (data, (row, col)), shape=(n_size + 1, n_size + 1), dtype=float
1450	        )
1451	
1452	        return csc_matrix(k_lg, dtype=float), f_torsion

1914	            raise RuntimeError(msg)

1916	        try:

272	        """Calculates the section extreme fibres along and perpendicular to an axis.

279	            The location of the extreme fibres parallel (``u``) and perpendicular
280	            (``v``) to the axis, (``u_min``, ``u_max``, ``v_min``, ``v_max``)
281	        """
282	        # initialise mins and maxs
283	        pt = self.geometry.points[0]
284	        u, v = fea.principal_coordinate(phi=angle, x=pt[0], y=pt[1])
285	        u_min = u
286	        u_max = u
287	        v_min = v
288	        v_max = v

290	        # loop through all nodes in the mesh
291	        for pt in self.geometry.points[1:]:
292	            # determine the coordinate of the point wrt the axis
293	            u, v = fea.principal_coordinate(phi=angle, x=pt[0], y=pt[1])

295	            # update the mins and maxes where necessary
296	            u_min = min(u_min, u)
297	            u_max = max(u_max, u)

303	    def pc_algorithm(
304	        self,
305	        u: tuple[float, float],
306	        dlim: tuple[float, float],
307	        axis: int,
308	        verbose: bool,
309	    ) -> tuple[float, RootResults]:
310	        """Plastic centroid algorithm.
311	
312	        An algorithm used for solving for the location of the plastic centroid. The
313	        algorithm searches for the location of the axis within the section depth
314	        (defined by unit vector ``u``) that satisfies force equilibrium.
315	
316	        Args:
317	            u: Unit vector pointing in the direction of the axis
318	            dlim: Distances from the centroid to the extreme fibres perpendicular to the
319	                axis (``dmax``, ``dmin``)
320	            axis: The current axis direction, 1 (i.e. ``x`` or ``11``) or 2 (i.e. ``y``
321	                or ``22``)
322	            verbose: If set to True, prints convergence information to the terminal
323	
324	        Returns:
325	            The perpendicular distance from the origin to the plastic centroid axis
326	            ``d``, and the ``scipy`` results object ``r`` - (``d``, ``r``)
327	        """
328	        # calculate vector perpendicular to u
329	        if axis == 1:
330	            u_p = np.array([-u[1], u[0]])
331	        else:
332	            u_p = np.array([u[1], -u[0]])
333	
334	        d, r = brentq(
335	            f=self.evaluate_force_eq,
336	            a=dlim[0],
337	            b=dlim[1],
338	            args=(u, u_p, verbose),
339	            full_output=True,
340	            disp=False,
341	            xtol=1e-6,
342	            rtol=1e-6,
343	        )
344	        return float(d), r

346	    def evaluate_force_eq(
347	        self,
348	        d: float,
349	        u: tuple[float, float],
350	        u_p: tuple[float, float],
351	        verbose: bool,
352	    ) -> float:
353	        """Evaluates force equilibrium.
354	
355	        Given a perpendicular distance ``d`` from the origin to an axis (defined by unit
356	        vector ``u``), calculates the force equilibrium between forces above and below
357	        that axis. The resultant force as a ratio of the total force, is returned.
358	
359	        Args:
360	            d: Perpendicular distance from the origin to the current axis
361	            u: Unit vector defining the direction of the axis
362	            u_p: Unit vector perpendicular to the direction of the axis
363	            verbose: If set to True, prints convergence information to the terminal
364	
365	        Returns:
366	            The force equilibrium norm
367	        """
368	        # p = finding a point on the axis by scaling the perpendicular
369	        p = d * u_p[0], d * u_p[1]
370	
371	        # calculate force equilibrium
372	        f_top, f_bot = self.calculate_plastic_force(u=u, p=p)
373	
374	        # calculate the force norm
375	        f_norm = (f_top - f_bot) / (f_top + f_bot)
376	
377	        # print verbose results
378	        if verbose:
379	            print(f"d = {d}; f_norm = {f_norm}")
380	
381	        # return the force norm (target for the root finding algorithm)
382	        return f_norm

384	    def calculate_plastic_force(
385	        self,
386	        u: tuple[float, float],
387	        p: tuple[float, float],
388	    ) -> tuple[float, float]:
389	        """Calculates the plastic force above and below an axis line.
390	
391	        Sums the forces above and below the axis line defined by unit vector ``u`` and
392	        point ``p``.
393	
394	        Args:
395	            u: Unit vector defining the direction of the axis line
396	            p: Point on the axis line
397	
398	        Returns:
399	            Force in the above and below the axis line (``f_top``, ``f_bot``)
400	        """
401	        # initialise variables
402	        f_top, f_bot = 0.0, 0.0
403	        a_top, a_bot = 0.0, 0.0
404	        qx_top, qx_bot = 0.0, 0.0
405	        qy_top, qy_bot = 0.0, 0.0
406	
407	        # split geometry above and below the line
408	        top_geoms, bot_geoms = self.geometry.split_section(point_i=p, vector=u)
409	
410	        if top_geoms:
411	            # loop through all top geometries
412	            for top_geom in top_geoms:
413	                # get properties
414	                f_y = top_geom.material.yield_strength
415	                area_top = top_geom.calculate_area()
416	                cx, cy = top_geom.calculate_centroid()
417	
418	                # sum properties
419	                a_top += area_top
420	                qx_top += cy * area_top
421	                qy_top += cx * area_top
422	                f_top += f_y * area_top
423	
424	        if bot_geoms:
425	            # loop through all bottom geometries
426	            for bot_geom in bot_geoms:
427	                # get properties
428	                f_y = bot_geom.material.yield_strength
429	                area_bot = bot_geom.calculate_area()
430	                cx, cy = bot_geom.calculate_centroid()
431	
432	                # sum properties
433	                a_bot += area_bot
434	                qx_bot += cy * area_bot
435	                qy_bot += cx * area_bot
436	                f_bot += f_y * area_bot
437	
438	        # calculate centroid of force action
439	        try:
440	            self._c_top = [qy_top / a_top, qx_top / a_top]
441	            self._f_top = f_top
442	        except ZeroDivisionError:
443	            self._c_top = [0.0, 0.0]
444	            self._f_top = 0.0
445	
446	        try:
447	            self._c_bot = [qy_bot / a_bot, qx_bot / a_bot]
448	        except ZeroDivisionError:
449	            self._c_bot = [0.0, 0.0]
450	
451	        return f_top, f_bot

64	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)  # type: ignore
65	def _assemble_torsion(
66	    k_el: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
67	    f_el: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
68	    c_el: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
69	    n: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
70	    b: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
71	    weight: float,
72	    nx: float,
73	    ny: float,
74	) -> tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float64], npt.NDArray[np.float64], npt.NDArray[np.float64]]:
75	    """Utility function for calculating the torsion stiffness matrix and load vector.
76	
77	    Args:
78	        k_el: Element stiffness matrix
79	        f_el: Element load vector
80	        c_el: Element constraint vector
81	        n: Shape function
82	        b: Strain matrix
83	        weight: Effective weight
84	        nx: Global x-coordinate
85	        ny: Global y-coordinate
86	
87	    Returns:
88	        Torsion stiffness matrix and load vector (``k_el``, ``f_el``, ``c_el``)
89	    """
90	    # calculated modulus weighted stiffness matrix and load vector
91	    k_el += weight * b.transpose() @ b
92	    f_el += weight * b.transpose() @ np.array([ny, -nx])
93	    c_el += weight * n
94	    return k_el, f_el, c_el

97	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)  # type: ignore
98	def _shear_parameter(
99	    nx: float, ny: float, ixx: float, iyy: float, ixy: float
100	) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:
101	    """Utility function for calculating the shear parameters.
102	
103	    Args:
104	        nx: Global x-coordinate
105	        ny: Global y-coordinate
106	        ixx: Second moment of area about the centroidal x-axis
107	        iyy: Second moment of area about the centroidal y-axis
108	        ixy: Second moment of area about the centroidal xy-axis
109	
110	    Returns:
111	        Shear parameters (``r``, ``q``, ``d1``, ``d2``, ``h1``, ``h2``)
112	    """
113	    # determine shear parameters
114	    r = nx**2 - ny**2
115	    q = 2 * nx * ny
116	    d1 = ixx * r - ixy * q
117	    d2 = ixy * r + ixx * q
118	    h1 = -ixy * r + iyy * q
119	    h2 = -iyy * r - ixy * q
120	    return r, q, d1, d2, h1, h2

123	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)  # type: ignore
124	def _assemble_shear_load(
125	    f_psi: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
126	    f_phi: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
127	    b: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
128	    n: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
129	    weight: float,
130	    nx: float,
131	    ny: float,
132	    ixx: float,
133	    iyy: float,
134	    ixy: float,
135	    nu: float,
136	) -> tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float64], npt.NDArray[np.float64]]:
137	    """Utility function for calculating the shear load vectors.
138	
139	    Args:
140	        f_psi: Values of the psi shear function at the element nodes
141	        f_phi: Values of the phi shear function at the element nodes
142	        b: Strain matrix
143	        n: Shape function
144	        weight: Effective weight
145	        nx: Global x-coordinate
146	        ny: Global y-coordinate
147	        ixx: Second moment of area about the centroidal x-axis
148	        iyy: Second moment of area about the centroidal y-axis
149	        ixy: Second moment of area about the centroidal xy-axis
150	        nu: Poisson's ratio
151	
152	    Returns:
153	        Shear load vectors (``f_psi``, ``f_phi``)
154	    """
155	    r, q, d1, d2, h1, h2 = _shear_parameter(nx, ny, ixx, iyy, ixy)
156	
157	    f_psi += weight * (
158	        nu / 2 * b.transpose() @ np.array([d1, d2])
159	        + 2 * (1 + nu) * n * (ixx * nx - ixy * ny)
160	    )
161	    f_phi += weight * (
162	        nu / 2 * b.transpose() @ np.array([h1, h2])
163	        + 2 * (1 + nu) * n * (iyy * ny - ixy * nx)
164	    )
165	    return f_psi, f_phi

168	@njit(cache=True, nogil=True)  # type: ignore
169	def _assemble_shear_coefficients(
170	    kappa_x: float,
171	    kappa_y: float,
172	    kappa_xy: float,
173	    psi_shear: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
174	    phi_shear: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
175	    b: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
176	    weight: float,
177	    nx: float,
178	    ny: float,
179	    ixx: float,
180	    iyy: float,
181	    ixy: float,
182	    nu: float,
183	) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
184	    """Utility function for calculating the shear deformation coefficients.
185	
186	    Args:
187	        kappa_x: Shear deformation coefficient about the x-axis
188	        kappa_y: Shear deformation coefficient about the y-axis
189	        kappa_xy: Shear deformation coefficient about the xy-axis
190	        psi_shear: Values of the psi shear function at the element nodes
191	        phi_shear: Values of the phi shear function at the element nodes
192	        b: Strain matrix
193	        weight: Effective weight
194	        nx: Global x-coordinate
195	        ny: Global y-coordinate
196	        ixx: Second moment of area about the centroidal x-axis
197	        iyy: Second moment of area about the centroidal y-axis
198	        ixy: Second moment of area about the centroidal xy-axis
199	        nu: Poisson's ratio
200	
201	    Returns:
202	        Shear deformation coefficients (``kappa_x``, ``kappa_y``, ``kappa_xy``)
203	
204	    """
205	    r, q, d1, d2, h1, h2 = _shear_parameter(nx, ny, ixx, iyy, ixy)
206	
207	    b_psi_d = b @ psi_shear - nu / 2 * np.array([d1, d2])  # 2x1
208	    b_phi_h = b @ phi_shear - nu / 2 * np.array([h1, h2])  # 2x1
209	
210	    kappa_x += weight * b_psi_d.dot(b_psi_d)  # 6.133
211	    kappa_y += weight * b_phi_h.dot(b_phi_h)  # 6.137
212	    kappa_xy += weight * b_psi_d.dot(b_phi_h)  # 6.140
213	    return kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy

217	class Tri6:
218	    """Class for a six-node quadratic triangular element.
219	
220	    Provides methods for the calculation of section properties based on the finite
221	    element method.
222	
223	    Args:
224	        el_id (int): Unique element id
225	        coords (numpy.ndarray): A ``2 x 6`` array of the coordinates of the Tri6 nodes.
226	            The first three columns relate to the vertices of the triangle and the last
227	            three columns correspond to the mid-nodes.
228	        node_ids (list[int]): A list of the global node ids for the current element
229	        material (Material): Material object for the current finite element
230	    """
231	
232	    el_id: int
233	    coords: npt.NDArray[np.float64]
234	    node_ids: list[int]
235	    material: Material
236	
237	    # _m and _x0 are used for global coord to local coord mapping
238	    _m: npt.NDArray[np.float64] = field(init=False)
239	    _x0: npt.NDArray[np.float64] = field(init=False)
240	
241	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
242	        """Sets up the global to local mapping."""
243	        # Create a mapping from global elm to local elm (unit triangle)
244	        # The result is used in the global to local mapping:
245	        # (eta, xi) = _M(x_global-_x0), zeta = 1-eta-xi
246	        p0, p1, self._x0 = self.coords[:, 0:3].transpose()
247	
248	        # Shift the triangle so the x_3 vertex (global) is on the origin
249	        # ((eta, xi, zeta) = (0,0,1))
250	        # Aside: This is chosen to be consistent with the shape function definitions.
251	        # At (0,0,1), N3=1, N1=N2=N4=...=0 (see Theoretical Background documentation)
252	        # since (x, y) = (sum(N_i(eta,xi,zeta)*x_i),  sum(N_i(eta,xi,zeta)*y_i)
253	        # then at (0,0,1): (x,y) = (x_3,y_3). ie: (x_3, y_3) => (0,0,1)
254	        r0 = p0 - self._x0
255	        r1 = p1 - self._x0
256	
257	        # Assemble the equations to solve for the transformation for the unit triangle
258	        x = np.array([r0, r1]).transpose()
259	        b = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1]])
260	        self._m = np.linalg.solve(x, b)
261	
262	    def __repr__(self) -> str:

266	            String representation of the Tri6 object
267	        """
268	        rep = f"el_id: {self.el_id}\ncoords: {self.coords}\n"
269	        rep += f"node_ids: {self.node_ids}\nmaterial: {self.material}"
270	        return rep

399	    def shear_warping_integrals(
400	        self,
401	        ixx: float,

405	    ) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:
406	        """Calculates the element shear centre and warping integrals for shear analysis.
407	
408	        Args:
409	            ixx: Second moment of area about the centroidal x-axis
410	            iyy: Second moment of area about the centroidal y-axis
411	            ixy: Second moment of area about the centroidal xy-axis
412	            omega: Values of the warping function at the element nodes
413	
414	        Returns:
415	            Shear centre integrals about the ``x`` and ``y`` axes and warping integrals
416	            (``sc_xint``, ``sc_yint``, ``q_omega``, ``i_omega``, ``i_xomega``,
417	            ``i_yomega``)
418	        """
419	        # initialise integrals
420	        sc_xint: float = 0.0
421	        sc_yint: float = 0.0
422	        q_omega: float = 0.0
423	        i_omega: float = 0.0
424	        i_xomega: float = 0.0
425	        i_yomega: float = 0.0
426	
427	        # Gauss points for 4 point Gaussian integration
428	        gps = gauss_points(n=4)
429	
430	        for gp in gps:
431	            # determine shape function, shape function derivative,
432	            # jacobian and global coordinates
433	            n, _, j, nx, ny = shape_function(coords=self.coords, gauss_point=gp)
434	
435	            weight = gp[0] * j * self.material.elastic_modulus
436	
437	            n_omega = np.dot(n, omega)
438	
439	            sc_xint += weight * (iyy * nx + ixy * ny) * (nx**2 + ny**2)
440	            sc_yint += weight * (ixx * ny + ixy * nx) * (nx**2 + ny**2)
441	            q_omega += weight * n_omega
442	            i_omega += weight * n_omega**2
443	            i_xomega += weight * nx * n_omega
444	            i_yomega += weight * ny * n_omega

483	            weight = gp[0] * j * self.material.elastic_modulus
484	
485	            # determine shear parameters
486	            kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy = _assemble_shear_coefficients(
487	                kappa_x,
488	                kappa_y,
489	                kappa_xy,
490	                psi_shear,
491	                phi_shear,
492	                b,
493	                weight,
494	                nx,
495	                ny,
496	                ixx,
497	                iyy,
498	                ixy,
499	                nu,
500	            )
501	
502	        return kappa_x, kappa_y, kappa_xy

504	    def monosymmetry_integrals(
505	        self,
506	        phi: float,
507	    ) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
508	        """Calculates the integrals used to evaluate the monosymmetry constants.
509	
510	        Args:
511	            phi: Principal bending axis angle, in degrees
512	
513	        Returns:
514	            Integrals used to evaluate the monosymmetry constants (``int_x``, ``int_y``,
515	            ``int_11``, ``int_22``)
516	        """
517	        # initialise properties
518	        int_x: float = 0.0
519	        int_y: float = 0.0
520	        int_11: float = 0.0
521	        int_22: float = 0.0
522	
523	        # Gauss points for 4 point Gaussian integration
524	        gps = gauss_points(n=4)
525	
526	        for gp in gps:
527	            # determine shape function,
528	            # jacobian and global coordinates
529	            _, _, j, nx, ny = shape_function(coords=self.coords, gauss_point=gp)
530	
531	            weight = gp[0] * j * self.material.elastic_modulus
532	
533	            # determine 11 and 22 position at Gauss point
534	            nx_11, ny_22 = principal_coordinate(phi=phi, x=nx, y=ny)
535	
536	            # weight the monosymmetry integrals by the section elastic modulus
537	            int_x += weight * (nx * nx * ny + ny * ny * ny)
538	            int_y += weight * (ny * ny * nx + nx * nx * nx)
539	            int_11 += weight * (nx_11 * nx_11 * ny_22 + ny_22 * ny_22 * ny_22)
540	            int_22 += weight * (ny_22 * ny_22 * nx_11 + nx_11 * nx_11 * nx_11)
541	
542	        return int_x, int_y, int_11, int_22

544	    def element_stress(
545	        self,
546	        n: float,
547	        mxx: float,
548	        myy: float,
549	        m11: float,
550	        m22: float,
551	        mzz: float,
552	        vx: float,
553	        vy: float,
554	        ea: float,
555	        cx: float,
556	        cy: float,
557	        ixx: float,
558	        iyy: float,
559	        ixy: float,
560	        i11: float,
561	        i22: float,
562	        phi: float,
563	        j: float,
564	        nu: float,
565	        omega: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
566	        psi_shear: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
567	        phi_shear: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
568	        delta_s: float,
569	    ) -> tuple[
570	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
571	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
572	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
573	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
574	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
575	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
576	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
577	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
578	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
579	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
580	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
581	        npt.NDArray[np.float64],
582	    ]:
583	        r"""Calculates the stress within an element resulting from a specified loading.
584	
585	        Args:
586	            n: Axial force
587	            mxx: Bending moment about the centroidal xx-axis
588	            myy: Bending moment about the centroidal yy-axis
589	            m11: Bending moment about the centroidal 11-axis
590	            m22: Bending moment about the centroidal 22-axis
591	            mzz: Torsion moment about the centroidal zz-axis
592	            vx: Shear force acting in the x-direction
593	            vy: Shear force acting in the y-direction
594	            ea: Modulus weighted area
595	            cx: x position of the elastic centroid
596	            cy: y position of the elastic centroid
597	            ixx: Second moment of area about the centroidal x-axis
598	            iyy: Second moment of area about the centroidal y-axis
599	            ixy: Second moment of area about the centroidal xy-axis
600	            i11: Second moment of area about the principal 11-axis
601	            i22: Second moment of area about the principal 22-axis
602	            phi: Principal bending axis angle
603	            j: St. Venant torsion constant
604	            nu: Effective Poisson's ratio for the cross-section
605	            omega: Values of the warping function at the element nodes
606	            psi_shear: Values of the psi shear function at the element nodes
607	            phi_shear: Values of the phi shear function at the element nodes
608	            delta_s: Cross-section shear factor
609	
610	        Returns:
611	            Tuple containing element stresses and integration weights
612	            (:math:`\sigma_{zz,n}`, :math:`\sigma_{zz,mxx}`,
613	            :math:`\sigma_{zz,myy}`, :math:`\sigma_{zz,m11}`,
614	            :math:`\sigma_{zz,m22}`, :math:`\sigma_{zx,mzz}`,
615	            :math:`\sigma_{zy,mzz}`, :math:`\sigma_{zx,vx}`,
616	            :math:`\sigma_{zy,vx}`, :math:`\sigma_{zx,vy}`,
617	            :math:`\sigma_{zy,vy}`, :math:`w_i`)
618	        """
619	        n_points: int = 6
620	
621	        # calculate axial stress
622	        sig_zz_n = n * np.ones(n_points) * self.material.elastic_modulus / ea
623	
624	        # initialise stresses at the gauss points
625	        sig_zz_mxx_gp = np.zeros(n_points)
626	        sig_zz_myy_gp = np.zeros(n_points)
627	        sig_zz_m11_gp = np.zeros(n_points)
628	        sig_zz_m22_gp = np.zeros(n_points)
629	        sig_zxy_mzz_gp = np.zeros((n_points, 2), order="F")
630	        sig_zxy_vx_gp = np.zeros((n_points, 2), order="F")
631	        sig_zxy_vy_gp = np.zeros((n_points, 2), order="F")
632	
633	        # Gauss points for 6 point Gaussian integration
634	        gps = gauss_points(n=n_points)
635	
636	        for i, gp in enumerate(gps):
637	            # determine x and y positions with respect to the centroidal axis
638	            coords_c = np.zeros((2, 6))
639	            coords_c[0, :] = self.coords[0, :] - cx
640	            coords_c[1, :] = self.coords[1, :] - cy
641	
642	            # determine shape function, shape function derivative,
643	            # jacobian and global coordinates
644	            _, b, _, nx, ny = shape_function(coords=coords_c, gauss_point=gp)
645	
646	            # determine 11 and 22 position at Gauss point
647	            nx_11, ny_22 = principal_coordinate(phi=phi, x=nx, y=ny)
648	
649	            # determine shear parameters
650	            r, q, d1, d2, h1, h2 = _shear_parameter(nx, ny, ixx, iyy, ixy)
651	
652	            # calculate element stresses
653	            sig_zz_mxx_gp[i] = self.material.elastic_modulus * (
654	                -(ixy * mxx) / (ixx * iyy - ixy**2) * nx
655	                + (iyy * mxx) / (ixx * iyy - ixy**2) * ny
656	            )
657	            sig_zz_myy_gp[i] = self.material.elastic_modulus * (
658	                -(ixx * myy) / (ixx * iyy - ixy**2) * nx
659	                + (ixy * myy) / (ixx * iyy - ixy**2) * ny
660	            )
661	            sig_zz_m11_gp[i] = self.material.elastic_modulus * m11 / i11 * ny_22
662	            sig_zz_m22_gp[i] = self.material.elastic_modulus * -m22 / i22 * nx_11
663	
664	            if mzz != 0:
665	                sig_zxy_mzz_gp[i, :] = (
666	                    self.material.elastic_modulus
667	                    * mzz
668	                    / j
669	                    * (b.dot(omega) - np.array([ny, -nx]))
670	                )
671	
672	            if vx != 0:
673	                sig_zxy_vx_gp[i, :] = (
674	                    self.material.elastic_modulus
675	                    * vx
676	                    / delta_s
677	                    * (b.dot(psi_shear) - nu / 2 * np.array([d1, d2]))
678	                )
679	
680	            if vy != 0:
681	                sig_zxy_vy_gp[i, :] = (
682	                    self.material.elastic_modulus
683	                    * vy
684	                    / delta_s
685	                    * (b.dot(phi_shear) - nu / 2 * np.array([h1, h2]))
686	                )
687	
688	        # extrapolate results to nodes
689	        sig_zz_mxx = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zz_mxx_gp)
690	        sig_zz_myy = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zz_myy_gp)
691	        sig_zz_m11 = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zz_m11_gp)
692	        sig_zz_m22 = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zz_m22_gp)
693	        sig_zx_mzz = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_mzz_gp[:, 0])
694	        sig_zy_mzz = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_mzz_gp[:, 1])
695	        sig_zx_vx = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_vx_gp[:, 0])
696	        sig_zy_vx = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_vx_gp[:, 1])
697	        sig_zx_vy = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_vy_gp[:, 0])
698	        sig_zy_vy = extrapolate_to_nodes(w=sig_zxy_vy_gp[:, 1])
699	
700	        return (
701	            sig_zz_n,
702	            sig_zz_mxx,
703	            sig_zz_myy,
704	            sig_zz_m11,
705	            sig_zz_m22,
706	            sig_zx_mzz,
707	            sig_zy_mzz,
708	            sig_zx_vx,
709	            sig_zy_vx,
710	            sig_zx_vy,
711	            sig_zy_vy,
712	            gps[:, 0],
713	        )
